fields.description: The policy the sender applied: sts (MTA-STS), tlsa (DANE) or no-policy-found when the domain publishes neither.
fields.label: Policy Type

fields.description: The domain the policy is published for.
fields.label: Policy Domain

fields.description: Connections that negotiated TLS the way the policy asks for.
fields.label: Successful Sessions

fields.description: Connections that could not negotiate TLS the way the policy asks for.
fields.label: Failed Sessions

fields.description: The MX host patterns the policy covers, one per line; MTA-STS policies list them.
fields.label: MX Hosts

fields.description: The policy as the sender retrieved it, one string per line: the lines of the MTA-STS policy file or the TLSA records.
fields.label: Policy
